items.title: Bob Shoffner Interview, 1959-09-08
items.q: And then I spent a band we struck that was Joe Oliver, myself, Paul Baldwin, Louis Russell, Bud Scott, our, our, our, Donnell Howard, Albert Nicholas, and our, Bonnie.

ctx.x: Was Keppert much of a reader, do you remember? Yeah. He could read all right then. He could read all right. We never did know for sure.
He could read all right. He was a, well, he was a much, I would say a much faster reader than Joe Oliver.
